units: <cite ref="Ketubot 60a:3">Keth. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>בד׳ דנשי</he> in a row of women.

<cite ref="Chullin 11a:1">Ḥull. 11ᵃ</cite> top <he>ד׳ דגברי</he> a row of men.
<cite ref="Chullin 47a:4">Ib. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>בד׳ דאוני</he> within the ranges of the lobes of the lungs.
<cite ref="Chullin 53a:14">Ib. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>בד׳ דסיחופיה</he> in the order in which the claws of the lion’s paw appear when he assaults an animal.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 97b:11">Snh. 97ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ קמא דקמי וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ד׳ דקמי</he>; Ms. K. a. Ar. <cite ref="D01080"><he>דָּרֵי</he></cite>, pl.) the first row (of righteous men) before the Lord; <cite ref="Sukkah 45b:5">Succ. 45ᵇ</cite> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 9).—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 36b">Kidd. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>ר״י דדריה</he> R. J. his class-mate; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="D00898"><he>דָּרִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="D01080"><he>דָּרֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Megillah 12a:15">Meg. 12ᵃ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="D01024"><he>דַּר</he></cite>, <cite ref="Esther 1:6">Esth. I, 6</cite>) <he>ד׳ ד׳</he> ranges of mosaics.
<cite ref="Niddah 20a:77">Nidd. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>תלתא ד׳ וכ׳</he> there are three ranges of leaves, and three leaves in each.
<cite ref="Berakhot 28a:1">Ber. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ חיוורתא</he> rows of white hair.
<cite ref="Berakhot 62b">Ib. 62ᵇ</cite> (phonetic etymol. of <cite ref="S01761"><he>קפנדריא</he></cite>) <he>אַדָּ׳ וכ׳ אדמקיפנא</he> in place of going around the rows of houses &c.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4:2">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite> <he>ד׳ יקידא יקדת</he> a burning pyre hast thou set on fire, v. <cite ref="J00557"><he>יְקַד</he></cite>.—Pl. as above.
